title: New Cue
emotional_thesis: Move from curiosity to earned confidence without losing forward motion.

musical_identity.motif: Rising fourth answered by two short descending steps
musical_identity.harmonic_language: Dorian field with a clear i-IV modal turn
musical_identity.bass_behavior: Root-led motion that opens into stepwise links at phrase ends
musical_identity.groove: Two broad 6/8 pulses with a light push into each second bar
musical_identity.silence_budget: Leave the final eighth of each two-bar phrase open for the answer
musical_identity.loop_strategy: Hold the last dominant color under a pickup that resolves on the first downbeat
